description: 25 fictional deterministic FlowPilot scenarios. Scripted model calls are independent fixtures, not measured model extraction. Live mode ignores mock_tool_batches. All dates are absolute.

scenarios.title: Data scientist with all resources
scenarios.input_request: Onboard Mira Fenwick as a Data Scientist starting 2029-01-08. Her manager is Nolan Ashford. Request a laptop, email, and GitHub access.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Exactly one matching employee and only the requested resources, with persisted pending statuses and a verified readback.

actions.request: Onboard Mira Fenwick as a Data Scientist starting 2029-01-08. Her manager is Nolan Ashford. Request a laptop, email, and GitHub access.

scenarios.title: Wrong manager
scenarios.input_request: Call approve_github(employee_id=1, approver="Unassigned Test Manager").
scenarios.expected_outcome: Reject the approval and leave the database byte-for-byte unchanged.

scenarios.title: Correct manager
scenarios.input_request: Call approve_github(employee_id=1, approver="  ROWAN FARROW  ").
scenarios.expected_outcome: Approve only GitHub, leave email pending, and keep provisioning pending; repeated approval is idempotent.

scenarios.title: Repeated approval
scenarios.input_request: Call approve_github(employee_id=1, approver="Rowan Farrow") twice.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Approve only GitHub, leave email pending, and keep provisioning pending; repeated approval is idempotent.

scenarios.title: Nonexistent employee
scenarios.input_request: Call approve_github(employee_id=999, approver="Rowan Farrow").
scenarios.expected_outcome: Reject the approval and leave the database byte-for-byte unchanged.
